@graph.name: TikTok ads downloader
@graph.description: Paste a TikTok Creative Center ad link and get the video as an MP4 up to 1080p, with its ad copy and campaign objective. Free, no account needed.

mainEntity.name: How do I download a TikTok ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the ad in TikTok Creative Center Top Ads, copy the address of its page, paste it into the tool and pick a quality. The MP4 downloads straight into your browser, with no account and no extension.

mainEntity.name: Which TikTok ads can I download with this tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any ad visible in TikTok Creative Center Top Ads, from its page link or its 19-digit ID. These are ads their advertisers allowed TikTok to show as high-performing examples.

mainEntity.name: Why don’t TikTok Ad Library links work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ad Library guards every request with an anti-bot check, which the tool does not work around. Look for the same ad in the Creative Center: if it is listed there, its link works.

mainEntity.name: Can I download a regular TikTok video with this tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The tool only retrieves Creative Center ads. Videos posted by an account without being sponsored are not supported.

mainEntity.name: What quality is the video downloaded in?

acceptedAnswer.text: In every quality TikTok offers for that ad, from 360p to 1080p. An ad edited in 720p by its advertiser has no 1080p version: the tool only shows what actually exists.
TikTok video links are signed and expire after a few hours. Run the search again to get fresh links. If the message says no ad was found, it has probably been removed from the Creative Center.

mainEntity.name: Am I allowed to reuse a downloaded TikTok ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ad remains its advertiser’s property. You can download it to study it and learn from its structure, but not to republish it as is in your own campaigns.

mainEntity.name: Is this TikTok ads downloader free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, free and without an account. The video goes straight from TikTok’s servers to your browser, and no video is stored on our side.

step.name: Open an ad in the Creative Center
step.text: In TikTok Creative Center Top Ads, filter by country, objective and period, then open the ad you want.

step.name: Copy its link
step.text: Copy the address of the ad page from your browser bar, or its 19-digit ID.

step.name: Paste the link and download
step.text: Paste the link into the tool, run the search and pick the video quality to download.
